title: VibeMux dual-track TaskBoard Lite acceptance
notice: This is an acceptance specification, not a test runner or observed result. Commands described by the companion development prompt are target interfaces to implement.

product.name: TaskBoard Lite
product.product_dependencies: Node.js standard library; plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript

task_schema.id: nonempty unique stable string assigned by server
task_schema.title: trimmed string, 1..120 Unicode code points

product.persistence: successful mutation persisted before response; orderly restart; no silent corruption reset; no lost single-process concurrent updates

cooperative_mode.required_exchange: B asks A for a source-backed edge-case explanation; bundle delivered at a safe turn boundary; source, recipient prompt and acknowledgment recorded
cooperative_mode.integration: approved immutable artifacts assembled in a new owned integration worktree; no mutation of original checkout; no automatic commit/merge/push

comparison_mode.subject: TaskBoard storage and validation component

contract_details.list: returns insertion order; mutating returned data must not bypass persistence rules
contract_details.add: non-string => invalid_request; trimmed blank or >120 code points => invalid_title; duplicate title allowed
contract_details.setCompleted: non-string/empty id or non-boolean completed => invalid_request; missing valid id => not_found
contract_details.remove: non-string/empty id => invalid_request; missing valid id => not_found
contract_details.createStore: missing file creates empty store; corrupt existing file rejects with corrupt_store and does not erase it
contract_details.errors: rejected Error with stable string code; no HTTP dependency required
contract_details.concurrency: single-process awaited/concurrent successful mutations are not lost; multiple independently opened writers at once excluded

fairness: same declared route and budget policy
record all failed attempts and helper-model calls
comparison_mode.selection: hard gates first; predeclared metrics next; stable deterministic tie-breaker; no winner if both fail
comparison_mode.negative_test: separately labeled mutated candidate artifact, not falsely attributed to the live worker

live_policy_template.budget_note: These are proposed configurable ceilings, not performance estimates. Live admission must validate enforceability. Unknown usage/cost is not zero. Do not reduce existing model context-window settings.

scenarios.description: Existing baseline behavior remains compatible; relevant regression suites actually run.
Windows test/runtime resources are isolated; no shared ACL-marker mutation or unknown-process termination.
Fixed TaskSpec/template/policy inputs render byte-identical English; replay reuses the accepted artifact.
Dropped prohibitions, changed numbers, invented scope and missing requirement coverage are rejected.
Literal Unicode/code/paths and adversarial source text cannot change compiler policy or trigger unintended expansion.
User semantic edits produce a new contract generation; admitted old work is not silently mutated.
Two concurrent role routes through AAG do not cross-talk through global defaults or provider pinning.
Unsupported gateway/harness protocol capability is refused before coding admission.
Pre-output failover and post-output failure are distinguished; no stream stitching or blind tool replay.
Actual configured live model requests reach AAG; reported identity/usage and unknown fields are truthful.
Two eligible slots acquire separate workspaces and demonstrate real overlapping work.
Zero slots blocks/queues and one slot runs sequentially without inventing parallelism.
Slot loss/lease expiry cannot cause simultaneous ownership or stale completion.
The same admitted request cannot produce duplicated canonical effects across restart/retry.
Two real native TUI sessions are owned and visible on Windows; start/attach/focus/resize work.
Safe prompt submission, human input ownership, interruption and unknown-delivery handling work.
Structured/native handoff never runs two controllers; unsupported native resume is reported as context transfer.
Two distinct harness kinds perform real writable turns; initialize-only probes do not count.
A scoped source-backed bundle travels A→B and appears in a permitted recipient turn with a delivery receipt.
Unauthorized audience, forged sender, stale source, duplicate and out-of-order messages are handled correctly.
Secrets are excluded from ordinary logs/events; opt-in content retention and deletion boundaries are tested.
Reopening the supervisor/context view after restart does not lose acknowledged shares or forge missing content.
Artifact admission/integration rejects out-of-scope changes; any detected protected-path mutation fails the Run. Enforcement claims match the declared sandbox backend.
Snapshot collection includes permitted untracked files and detects candidate mutation after verification.
Dirty, mismatched or externally owned resources are retained, not cleaned or killed.
A protocol-completed but incorrect candidate cannot pass the workflow gate.
Fresh independent review and trusted verifier receipts refer to the exact same candidate and contract.
Both cooperative artifacts form a passing integration candidate without editing the user's original checkout.
The comparison selector refuses the defective candidate; both-fail does not select a winner.
A late canceled/stale workflow cannot be promoted by a delayed successful child result.
TaskBoard API validation, status/error contracts and persistence pass the trusted external test suite.
Real browser add/toggle/delete/filter/count/keyboard/error/Unicode/XSS checks pass.
One bounded repair closes an injected defect without modifying tests, requirements or historical evidence.
Optimizer proposals are restricted to allowed prompt/context/scheduling parameters.
Candidate evaluation uses fixed train/dev inputs and protected holdout; active contracts are unchanged.
Harmful/no-gain candidates are rejected; accepted policy versions are rollbackable and budget-bounded.
Exported report includes every scenario, failures, skips, commands, identities and supported claims.

full_pass_rule: Every required scenario has genuine supporting execution evidence for its required classes; simulated results do not substitute for live/native classes. No open hard-gate failures or missing mandatory evidence.

allowed: scheduler ranking weights within eligibility rules
self_optimization.evaluation: fixed train/dev sets; protected final holdout; explicit call/time budget; no claimed guaranteed improvement
self_optimization.promotion: future admissions only; versioned; rollbackable; reject regressions; no-gain may be valid result
